scope: All existing 81 census recordings and every final guarded multi-parent component. Component membership, passing GLRT selection and fixed GLRT weights are conditioned upon; they are not independent outer-held-out discoveries. Raw normalized CFO enters training-only unwrapping/alias alignment. Two repeats of outer5fold/inner3fold random whole2s blocks compare joined versus separate curves (one common selected degree across separate parents). No orbit bank, RF-dependent c, position fit or reference. Existing whole-recording development/validation roles remain unchanged.
